text:
Ana (Finance): ACME reporting much lower billed embed units for 2026-03-03. Ingress logs show lots of 429s and client retries. Can eng confirm if retries were deduped by billing?
Priya S: They opened INC-5421. Need quick estimate of missing billables to decide credit path.
Jo (Eng): Quick check: customer_id='acme', client_version in ('0.9.1','0.9.2','0.9.3') between 2026-03-03 and 2026-03-04 shows ingress_tokens 1,200,410 vs billed_tokens 710,120 -> gap ~490k tokens.
Mike W: Root cause likely legacy SDK reusing batch_id on retry. Our dedupe keys currently prefer client batch id causing retries to be dropped.
Jo (Eng): We can replay raw-ingress (kafka) with force-billable to recompute. Estimate 1.5-2h job and small S3 output. Will need finance sign-off before applying credits.
Priya S: Tentative credit calc: ~490k tokens -> approx $3.6k at embed rate (rough). Will refine after replay.
Ana (Finance): BillingBot, create credit request for review.
BillingBot: Credit request CR-9999 created by Ana. Amount pending.
CS:Lina: Hold customer comms - we'll wait for confirmed numbers then share a concise explanation.
Jo (Eng): Plan: run replay 06:00 UTC tomorrow, post delta + logs + checksum. Also will add a short-term patch to billing dedupe to prefer server request_id when present. Long-term: SDK fix already in 0.9.5.
Priya S: Filing approval workflow now; tagging VP sales if >$5k.
Ana (Finance): Action items summarized: Jo runs backfill and posts results, Priya finalizes credit request, CS drafts message after numbers are final, Eng ships dedupe patch.
Mike W: Also will run a scan across top-100 customers for similar deltas after ACME replay.
Ana (Finance): Thanks everyone.
